denominatorMethodologyNote: "Turnout of registered" divides ballots cast by everyone registered to vote by the time polls closed (pre-registered voters plus same-day registrants). "Turnout of CVAP" divides ballots cast by the citywide citizen voting-age population, a Census Bureau 5-year survey estimate with its own margin of error — it is not an exact count, and is null for a handful of cities the join could not resolve (see knownGaps in /turnout/city/2024.json).
